added: packages/adapters (@sos-2/adapters): the W12 adapter CONTRACTS with in-memory reference implementations — RepositoryAdapter (durable store for spine envelopes/trace links; the reference implementation delegates storage mechanics to the spine's own EnvelopeStore/TraceLinkStore), TelemetryIngestionAdapter (OTel-shaped batches -> raw observations through @sos-2/telemetry's convertOtelBatch, plus truthful gap recording as UNAVAILABLE observations), ReasoningProviderAdapter (LLM providers behind a reasoning-provider contract: prompt/complete with model id + version provenance on every output, outputs are structural bridges { content: JsonValue, producer: Producer }) and ExecutionAdapter (running candidate code: every request carries the AuthorityGrantArtifact + evaluation point; the reference implementation validates through @sos-2/authority's evaluateGrant BEFORE running — expired/revoked -> EXECUTION_DENIED with a structured denial, missing grant rejected loudly, undeclared operations rejected loudly, executed results carry truthful SUCCESS/FAILURE availability with the JSON output preserved)

the semantic bridge (semantic-bridge.ts): ADAPTERS CANNOT REDEFINE SEMANTICS — a closed registry of 10 bridgeable domain types (ArtifactId, ArtifactEnvelope, TraceLink, EvidenceTruthState, JsonValue from @sos-2/semantic-spine; Producer, TimeWindow from @sos-2/provenance; RawObservation from @sos-2/telemetry; EvidenceRecord from @sos-2/evidence; AuthorityGrant from @sos-2/authority), each entry naming the OWNING package and consuming its runtime guard VERBATIM; a TYPE-LEVEL guard (AdapterContractDescriptor.outputs is Record<string, DomainSemanticTypeName> — a novel semantic concept does not compile) plus a RUNTIME guard (assertValidAdapterDescriptor rejects cast-forged descriptors bridging to unregistered types; verifyAdapterOutputs rejects concrete outputs whose bridged fields fail the owning package's guard); the reference adapters run the guard LIVE on every produced output (per output-site descriptors, e.g. REPOSITORY_ENVELOPE_OUTPUT, REASONING_COMPLETION_OUTPUT, EXECUTION_RESULT_OUTPUT)

the non-authoritative LLM discipline (reasoning-provider.ts): reasoningOutputAsEvidence mints the W3 evidence record for a completion and returns it NARROWED to NonAuthoritativeEvidence (llm_output: true — the W3 layer derives the mark from the LLM-marked producer so it cannot be forged or stripped; a tampered record fails W3 validation, pinned by tests); assertNonAuthoritativeEvidence refuses any record whose mark is not exactly true; reasoningProducer guarantees every reasoning producer carries model + model_version

gap recording (telemetry-ingestion.ts): recordGap produces an UNAVAILABLE raw observation for a subject/window with NO DATA — data about missing data, never zero, never absence-of-failure (the architecture-lock forbidden shortcut)
preserved_invariants: platforms and vendors are adapters — they do not redefine SOS semantics (spec/architecture.md section 17 / R18): every adapter output is a structural bridge onto a domain type from the merged workspace packages; the domain type registry consumes the owning packages' guards verbatim and an adapter introducing a novel semantic concept is REJECTED at the type level AND at runtime (pinned by negative tests: a forged descriptor bridging to 'UnicornWidget' throws; a forged output failing the spine envelope guard throws)

LLM output is never authoritative evidence or authorization (spec/architecture.md section 18): reasoning completions carry LLM-marked producers (model + model_version); reasoningOutputAsEvidence returns records narrowed to llm_output: true; mark evasion (an unmarked producer) is rejected; tampering toward authority fails W3 validation AND the bridge assert (pinned by tests)

expired and revoked grants never authorize (the W1 invariant): the ExecutionAdapter consumes @sos-2/authority's evaluateGrant before running anything — EXPIRED/REVOKED -> EXECUTION_DENIED with structured reasons, the operation provably never runs (pinned by tests with run-flag probes); a missing grant is rejected loudly before evaluation

the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/kind/trace/serialization authority: the repository adapter stores and returns spine ArtifactEnvelope/TraceLink objects validated by the spine's own guards, delegating to the spine's EnvelopeStore/TraceLinkStore; no adapter mints ids, defines kinds or trace types, or reimplements canonical serialization (consumed from the spine)

unknown, failed, unavailable and unsupported remain distinct (spec/architecture.md section 18 / R21): telemetry ingestion preserves the converter's verbatim truth-state assignment; gaps are recorded as UNAVAILABLE (never zero, never absence-of-failure); execution denials (the operation never ran) are never reported as candidate failures (running-and-failing and refusing-to-run are distinct facts)

no frozen contract in spec/contracts/ was modified; spec/, docs/, root files and sibling-owned paths are untouched — all changes are additive under the owned path packages/adapters (the W12 owned-path contract)
boundary_changes: one new workspace package: @sos-2/adapters (runtime deps @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/provenance, @sos-2/telemetry, @sos-2/authority, @sos-2/evidence) — one-directional and acyclic: adapters consumes the merged W0.5/W1/W3 packages and is consumed by nothing at this base

the domain type registry is a BRIDGE authority (which workspace types adapter outputs may map onto), not a second semantic registry in the AGENTS.md section 4 sense: it registers no identities, kinds or trace types, invents no vocabulary of the spine's, and every guard is consumed from its owning package

adapter control-plane fields (denial codes GRANT_EXPIRED/GRANT_REVOKED, error strings, simulator diagnostics) are documented as operational metadata, not semantic payloads; every field carrying SOS semantic content is bridged and guarded
